validation.postRootChanges: Fixed Iris nested SDK scope identity validation; final Provider checks rerun. Runtime test fixture corrected and one lost verification ACK case added; four focused integration tests rerun. Root counts do not include that added case.

verified: Independent IrisRecallVerifier works with ordinary MemoryHost stopped, negotiates each batch through installed SDK and calls only bounded public recall revalidation HTTP with complete original bodies and a fresh batch deadline

Configured identity is matched against generic preparation metadata and actual SDK body.scope; duplicate inputs, unsupported capability/schema, oversized input, partial/duplicate/unknown/malformed responses and cancellation are rejected
DB Worker transmission admission revalidates current inventory and real privacy blocked state; preparation generation mismatches remain unchecked instead of being silently reauthorized

Phase4HistoryRevalidator fixes scope/provider/agent/space, reads persisted inventory coverage, batches at most 16 requests with distinct native ids and bounded body bytes, then persists exact original descriptor bindings
Cancellation and stopped lifecycle retain a busy slot until uncooperative work settles; late responses do not persist. Policy changes reject response writes

Twenty prepared attempts cross request-count/duplicate-id batch boundaries; restart resumes stored verdicts without repeated HTTP, and a lost Worker ACK after committed verification is recovered from durable coverage

Real installed Core probe now invokes the application maintenance coordinator and Iris verifier instead of manually saving a constructed response; request body equals captured original SDK HTTP, one remote verification occurs, three other facts remain unchecked and restart does not repeat HTTP
Final provider/runtime build passes Core/Chromium correction/deletion/checkpoint/history-gap regression and tools plus 24 existing recovery smoke cases

bounds.concurrency: one outstanding run per coordinator and one outstanding request per verifier, including uncooperative cancelled work

limits: Explicit trusted maintenance assembly is implemented; automatic Runtime startup/background scheduling and privacy lifecycle integration are not yet connected
Caller must stop normal MemoryHost or cancel maintenance before live privacy changes; local pre-send admission is not a cross-process lock covering remote HTTP
Older preparation policy generations require explicit historical privacy reauthorization and remain unchecked
Observation/Usage/other inventory facts, external StateStore and unbound legacy coverage, common cross-batch snapshot and safe atomic gap release remain incomplete
Actual backup/fork restore, full Stage/Core crash matrix, ENOSPC, total directory quota, long-growth, Phase4B and complete demo remain open
